g.text: Completed E051 and E052 studies | separate cohorts; no pooled estimate
Preserving strong weights reverses its ranking relative to full rewriting;
weaker weights are still rewritten. This is not protected copying.
Each study: 32 independent blocks, 512 lineages per condition. Saved pointwise 95% block intervals.
